Chapter 10.1, Determination of Sediment in Crude Oils and Fuel Oils by the Extraction Method, First Edition, April 1981 (ANSI/ASTM D 473) (IP 53)

This publication specifies a method for the determination of sediment in crude petroleum by extraction with toluene. 4 pages.

Price each, $4.00

852-30202

Chapter 10.2, Determination of Water in Crude Oil by Distillation, First Edition. April 1981 (ANSI/ASTM D 4006)(IP 358)

This publication specifies a method for the determination of water in crude petroleum by distillation. 13 pages.

Price each, $5.00
